title: TraceQA common types
description: Types shared by more than one contract.

Viewport.description: Size of the browser window content area, in CSS pixels.

Rect.description: A rectangle in CSS pixels. Inside a RawElement it is relative to that frame's document. Everywhere else it is relative to the top-level page.

BrowserTarget.description: Which browser to run in. The engine passes this to a driver and never interprets it.

browser.description: Browser name. Known values: chromium, chrome, msedge, firefox, webkit, safari, cdp, webdriver.

cdpEndpoint.description: WebSocket or HTTP endpoint of an already running browser. Used with browser = cdp.

webdriverUrl.description: URL of a W3C WebDriver server, local or a cloud grid. Used with browser = webdriver.

webdriverCapabilities.description: Capabilities to ask the WebDriver server for, for example { "browserName": "safari" }.

BrowserInfo.description: What actually ran, as reported by the driver.

Warning.description: Something that did not stop the run but that the reader should know.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Known values: cross_origin_frame_skipped, unnamed_interactive_element, scroll_limit_reached, frame_eval_failed, screenshot_failed, browsers_disagree.

ElementState.description: State of one element at the moment it was read.

visible.description: False when the element is hidden by CSS, has no size, or is inside a hidden ancestor.

Confidence.description: How sure we are that an element is interactive. Low means it only looks clickable (for example a div with a pointer cursor).
